claim_summary: Exactly 567 optimum three-sensor states on the Doyle–Holt graph; both jump and slide graphs connected, with diameters four and eight, and exactly 351 unordered pairs attaining a sharp five-slide excess.
integrity: Complete source and three replayable checkers are embedded, including a second group-theoretic graph representation; no external mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the 27-vertex Doyle–Holt graph and the specified standard synchronous power-domination rule, not for all half-arc-transitive graphs.
The finite exact proof uses reproducible exhaustive enumeration and graph symmetry; no infinite-family claim is made.
An equivalent unindexed table remains a possibility; the accessible literature comparison does not imply a uniqueness theorem.
title: Exact power-domination and five-step relocation obstructions in the Doyle–Holt graph
